constraints.name: element_form_power_two_minus_one
constraints.description: Each element of the array must be of the form 2^x - 1 for some integer x with 1 ≤ x ≤ 60.

constraints.name: xor_equals_c
constraints.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in the array must equal the given integer C.

constraints.name: minimal_array_size
constraints.description: The output array must have the smallest possible size among all arrays satisfying the element form and XOR constraints.
constraints.formal: n = min{ |A| : A satisfies element form and XOR condition }
